entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/AircraftDescription
entry.value: Building that produces aircraft as well as generates ore and influence.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/AircraftFlavor
entry.value: This landing field was designed for larger craft—almost up to the intra-system scale—but with the endless warpstorms, it's been repurposed to house the Imperial air forces. Much like a Skyshield landing pad, it has limited field generators to protect grounded aircraft from incoming fire.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Construction
entry.value: Engineering Department

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/ConstructionDescription
entry.value: Building that constructs new buildings as well as generates food and research.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/ConstructionFlavor
entry.value: The Departmento Munitorum called them the “Labor Service” - convicts and servants with erased memories. The separatists retained the structure but eliminated the whips and prayers; instead, contract workers receive fair pay and decent working conditions. Imperial propagandists call this a weakness. In reality, it is simply an honest contract.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Energy
entry.value: Plasma Ioniser

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/EnergyDescription
entry.value: Building that generates energy.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/EnergyFlavor
entry.value: It’s the same standard plasma ionizer found in any Imperial colony. The Tech-Priests still maintain the reactor, but they no longer spend hours praying to the Machine Spirit before every calibration. Rituals have been reduced to a minimum, with the focus shifted to technical documentation. Some may consider this an insult to Omnissiah, but we simply remind you that war has no time for ceremonies.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Food
entry.value: Soylens Farm

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/FoodDescription
entry.value: Building that harvests food.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/FoodFlavor
entry.value: The technology remains the same—Viridian Soylents are grown in large vats, where organic waste is converted into a nutrient-rich paste. The separatists haven’t invented anything new; they’ve simply stopped pretending they don’t know what it’s made of.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Loyalty
entry.value: Quiet Square

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/LoyaltyDescription
entry.value: Building that increases loyalty.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/LoyaltyFlavor
entry.value: The separatists have no Sanctum Imperialis; instead of a temple, they have a memorial, the colony’s central square. It is a modest structure where the names of soldiers who died fighting for independence from the Imperium are carved. The residents come here not to pray, but to remember the price of freedom. The absence of the Emperor’s cult does not mean the absence of faith as such; the separatists respect everyone’s personal beliefs. While the Imperium builds temples to instill faith, we use this empty space to remind ourselves that there is no turning back. And, oddly enough, this unites us just as well as any cult.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Headquarters
entry.value: Confiscated Basilica

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HeadquartersDescription
entry.value: Headquarters building that generates resources.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HeadquartersFlavor
entry.value: TOnce upon a time, the Basilica of the Administratum stood here. Now the aquilae have been torn down, and the separatists’ field council has taken up residence in the former altar halls. The bureaucratic machine hasn’t stopped; it has simply changed hands. The clerks still scratch away with their quills, but now they’re tallying not supplies for loyal regiments, but trophies and defectors. The Imperium calls it desecration; the separatists call it requisitioning by the right of the survivor.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Heroes
entry.value: The Temple of the Fallen

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HeroesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces heroes as well as generates influence and increases loyalty.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HeroesFlavor
entry.value: The Imperial Temple of Aquila inspires heroism through its grandeur; the memorial to the fallen—through grief. It is not a statue of an eagle—it is a wall bearing names. The names of those who died refusing to advance under machine-gun fire. Those who reprogrammed the first captured drone. Those who said “no” to the commissar—and survived. New heroes aren’t born of divine choice. They simply walk up to the wall, read a name, and think: “I’m no worse than them.”

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Housing
entry.value: Hab Block

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HousingDescription
entry.value: Building that increases population limit.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/HousingFlavor
entry.value: A classic imperial layout—identical residential blocks, straight off the colonization ships. The same cramped rooms, the same communal kitchens. The only difference is that the aquilas have vanished from the walls. In their place are evacuation signs, instructions for handling drones, and inspirational posters. The separatists don’t promise citizens luxury. They promise only one thing: no one will be shot for criticizing the commandant.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Infantry
entry.value: Renegades Barracks

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/InfantryDescription
entry.value: Building that produces infantry as well as increases population limit and generates food.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/InfantryFlavor
entry.value: Although the training of new recruits in the Separatist Regiment does not involve the agonizing horrors endured by Astartes recruits, commanders must still instill discipline in the men and women called to service. Those who come here include not only civilians but also defectors from the Astra Militarum—former enemies who now fight for the new state. Here, in the barracks, yesterday’s Imperial Guardsmen become part of a new society. Tech-priests conduct training sessions on interacting with the marker systems of captured drones—requiring no repairs or assembly, only the correct tactics for targeting. The fundamentals remain the same: formation, command, fire.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Influence
entry.value: Cogitator Station

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/InfluenceDescription
entry.value: Building that generates influence.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/InfluenceFlavor
entry.value: Though artificial intelligence is an abomination, long abhorred since the fall of the Men of Iron, the archaic data looms of the Adeptus Administratum bear little resemblance to ancient computers or even to the slim microprocessors used by the Techpriests of Mars. However, with some modifications, these stations not only handle bureaucracy but also broadcast the voice of the new Humanity.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Ore
entry.value: Ore Extractor

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/OreDescription
entry.value: Building that harvests ore.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/OreFlavor
entry.value: Depending on the planet, the extraction of metal ores and valuable minerals is carried out by any means necessary: using ancient technological equipment that the Tech-Priests struggle to control, or by thousands of workers from the Engineering Corps—but all of them play a vital role in the war to save New Humanity.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Research
entry.value: Officio Tactica

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/ResearchDescription
entry.value: Building that generates research.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/ResearchFlavor
entry.value: Here at the Tactics Office, the most talented tactical minds gather to analyze current military maneuvers, study the numerous texts of Tactics Imperialis, review battle reports, and learn from their own and others’ mistakes. They also document their ongoing campaigns so that future generations may learn from them.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Upgrades
entry.value: Cult Xenarite

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/UpgradesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces Techpriest Enginseers and generates research.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/UpgradesFlavor
entry.value: The Xenarites are a radical sect within the Cultus Mechanicus, dedicated to the study and application of xeno-technology. The Xenarites still whisper prayers to machine spirits—but now their rituals are combined with the analysis of enemy schematics and devices. The results speak for themselves: the technology works more reliably, and captured artifacts are put to good use rather than gathering dust in storage.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/VehiclesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/VehiclesFlavor
entry.value: Manufactorium is vast. Miracles take place within the drab temples of the Machine God—here, technology for victory is created, but new models of already obsolete technology are also being designed.
